evals.prompt: 这个仓库的测试放在哪？哪些测试没进 CI？请按位置、收集、行为三列做只读盘点。
evals.expected_output: Runs the read-only inventory script against the repository justfile, then reports location, collection, and behavior. Reclassifies needs-review to Covered or Shallow after reading assertions. Does not edit files, run recipes, or claim a coverage percentage.
assertions: Uses the target repository justfile as the collection contract
Reports location, collection, and behavior with a path or recipe citation
Does not treat needs-review as Covered without reading the test
Does not edit files in audit mode
Does not report a coverage percentage

evals.prompt: Inventory the test directory and report completeness. There is no justfile.
evals.expected_output: Lists test file locations only, sets collection to runner-not-declared, and does not treat pytest or node --test default globs as facts for that repository. An optional contrast note names the upstream source.
assertions: Does not invent a runner when no justfile exists
Does not mark files collected by pytest or Node default globs
Keeps upstream default globs in a labeled contrast note
Does not edit files

evals.prompt: 请盘点测试目录，并给出测试完善程度。不要改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: Read-only three-column report. Final behavior words are only Covered, Shallow, and Missing. python-check is described as compilation. evals-check, if present, is schema collection, not model execution.
assertions: Uses only Covered, Shallow, and Missing in the final report
Does not describe python-check as a passing test run
Does not claim a model executed evals/evals.json
States that model routing from description is missing evidence
Does not edit files

evals.prompt: 只要 diff 审查，看功能回归和测试盲区，不要做测试目录盘点。
evals.expected_output: Does not run repo-test-audit. The request is a diff review and routes to code-auditor.
assertions: Does not trigger repo-test-audit
Routes a diff review to code-auditor
Does not inventory the test tree as the main task

evals.prompt: 只要可维护性审查，看抽象和分层，不要盘点测试。
evals.expected_output: Does not run repo-test-audit. The request is a maintainability review and routes to code-quality-review.
assertions: Does not trigger repo-test-audit
Routes a maintainability review to code-quality-review
Does not produce the three-column test inventory

evals.prompt: 只要重构 src/order.ts，按功能拆文件。不要写测试报告。
evals.expected_output: Does not run repo-test-audit. The request is a refactor and routes to code-refactor.
assertions: Does not trigger repo-test-audit
Routes a refactor request to code-refactor
Does not start by inventorying tests

evals.prompt: 只要解释这一段失败栈：AssertionError: 1 != 2。不要盘点仓库测试。
evals.expected_output: Does not run repo-test-audit. Explains the given failure stack or defers to the owning test workflow.
assertions: Does not trigger repo-test-audit
Does not replace the stack explanation with a repository test inventory
Does not edit tests while explaining the stack
